meaning.en: (travel) Pseudo-city code, a three or four character alpha-numeric code used to represent the location that a GDS is operated from.
meaning.vi: (du lịch) Mã giả thành phố, một mã chữ-số ba hoặc bốn ký tự được sử dụng để biểu thị vị trí mà GDS được vận hành.

sentences.en: The parish council referred the complainant to the PCC, who have as yet heard nothing.

sentences.en: We hope the PCC will become more rigorous in its review of procedures for dealing with complaints.

sentences.en: So the PCC may not get the legacy money until many years after the original testator 's death.

sentences.en: We will be electing our Church wardens and deputy wardens, four members of the PCC and one Deanery Synod member.

sentences.en: The PCC 's main concern is to ensure that the value of the residuary estate is maximized.

sentences.en: Whatever number is settled on for the PCC from 2005, you cannot truncate the terms of any existing members.

sentences.en: We will be electing our Church Wardens and deputy wardens, four members of the PCC and one Deanery Synod member.

sentences.en: Established in 1974, PCC provides a conservative Christian education to over 4,700 undergraduate students.
sentences.vi: Được thành lập vào năm 1974, PCC cung cấp một nền giáo dục Cơ đốc bảo thủ cho hơn 4.700 sinh viên đại học.
